## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — the DCO check enforces this
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Packaging changes: the .deb still builds from a fresh clone
- [ ] Packaging changes: dependency and version changes are explained in the body
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal paths in the diff
